When a reading is refused, tell the reader every check that refuses it, not only the first: run all reading checks and collect their errors, without changing which readings pass. Also carry the refusals from the job's earlier reading rounds into the next round's reader brief, so a new round does not start blind at attempt 1. Seen in job 20261110-194015-cj54: 9 reader runs that swung between check_design_existing_code and check_reading_references, which cited crates/athena-core/src/throughput.rs, a file that does not exist. Also seen in job 20261029-110925-t8v1: 18 rounds, each starting at attempt 1. Acceptance: (1) a test with a reading that breaks two checks shows both refusal texts in the reader's retry brief; (2) a test shows round 2's first attempt includes round 1's last refusal; (3) the accept or refuse result for the existing reading-check test cases is unchanged; (4) fmt, clippy and tests pass; (5) a CHANGELOG.md entry.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: The reading gate stops at the first refusing check and each re-read round starts over at attempt 1, so readers swap one refusal for another across rounds
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: crates/athena-core/src/throughput.rs, CHANGELOG.md
